meta.title: RepoChan — Turn any repository into a living visual brand
meta.description: A local-first, agent-agnostic creative production protocol for mascot personas, consistent brand assets, and project websites.

hero.imageAlt: Repona holding a translucent mother-pattern board in a bright harbor workshop
hero.body: RepoChan guides your coding agent through analysis, persona design, foundation art, consistent assets, and an original project site — all as versioned local artifacts.

capabilities.title: Creative freedom, reliable handoffs.
capabilities.body: The protocol keeps the rails dependable while your own agent makes the creative calls.

items.title: Artifact-centric
items.body: Every stage leaves a schema-validated, versioned artifact you can inspect and recover.

items.title: Foundation-first
items.body: One approved visual anchor keeps characters, scenes, patterns, and pages recognizably consistent.

items.title: Your agent, your judgment
items.body: RepoChan supplies deterministic commands and creative skills — never an embedded model loop.
items.note: Bring Codex, Claude, Pi, or any agent

workflow.title: From repository signal to a brand you can ship.
workflow.body: Each team owns one clear handoff. The work stays creative because the boundaries stay explicit.

steps.title: Analyze
steps.body: Read structure, intent, and project weight.

steps.title: Persona
steps.body: Give the repository a voice and a world.

steps.title: Foundation
steps.body: Lock the character and visual anchor.

steps.title: Website
steps.body: Design for the real project and content.

principles.title: core + skill at the center
principles.body: Deterministic rules and creative judgment stay separate.

principles.title: CLI is the sole binding surface
agent is yours
principles.body: Bring your own model, tools, and working style.

principles.title: .repochan/ keeps versions
principles.body: Artifacts remain local, diff-friendly, and recoverable.

architecture.graphAriaLabel: CLI depends on core, skill, image generation, image editing, templates, and starters

gallery.title: Every beat leaves something real.
gallery.body: These are actual artifacts from this repository’s RepoChan run — not invented product metrics or stock examples.

cta.body: Bring the coding agent you already use. RepoChan gives it a dependable creative production protocol.

footer.line: Core keeps the rules · Skill supplies the ideas · Your agent does the work.
